name: GhostBound
detailed_description:
She wakes up in a strange world… with no memories, no guidance, and possibly… no heartbeat.

Ghostbound is a survival-action adventure set in the ruins of a forgotten spirit realm. Play as a mysterious girl stranded between life and death, and explore dreamlike islands haunted by spirits, ancient machines, and secrets that refuse to stay buried.

Build your shelter, craft your tools, and dive into combat with monsters guarding powerful souls. As you collect and seal them, you’ll uncover fragments of the world—and of yourself.

But you’re not alone. Some spirits talk. Some cry. Some… flirt.

Form bonds. Seal bosses. Talk back to ghosts.
This isn’t just about survival—this is about connection.

🌙 Key Features:

  • Semi-open world spirit islands with handcrafted dungeons and storylines

  • Survival-lite mechanics (crafting, shelter, farming, hunting)

  • Boss sealing & soul collection system

  • Companion system with evolving relationships

  • Real-time action combat with dodging, timing, and combos

  • Optional mature themes, with emotional + flirty dialogue

Ghostbound is a game about collecting more than items—it's about collecting stories, and deciding which ones to let go.

Explore floating islands, defeat spirit, and collect powerful souls to uncover the truth behind this strange realm
